name: JoAi: Update Project

description.en: Edit an existing project: name, brief, presets, platforms, skills, or the template values it renders from.
description.de: Bearbeite ein bestehendes Projekt: Name, Brief, Presets, Plattformen, Skills oder die Template-Werte, aus denen es gerendert wird.
description.es: Edit an existing project: name, brief, presets, platforms, skills, or the template values it renders from.
description.fr: Edit an existing project: name, brief, presets, platforms, skills, or the template values it renders from.
description.ro: Edit an existing project: name, brief, presets, platforms, skills, or the template values it renders from.
description.it: Edit an existing project: name, brief, presets, platforms, skills, or the template values it renders from.

bot: Use this when the user wants to change an existing project instead of creating a new one. Find the project with list_projects first. Editing the template block drops the previous render, so produce it again afterwards.

inputs.name: Project
inputs.bot: The hash ID of the project to edit.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.bot: Optional new project name. Leave out to keep the current one.

inputs.name: Brief
inputs.bot: Optional new creative brief. Leave out to keep the current one.

inputs.name: Output Preset

description.en: Output preset: 9:16 social, 16:9 launch, or 1:1 square teaser.
description.de: Ausgabe-Preset: 9:16 Social, 16:9 Launch oder 1:1 quadratischer Teaser.

inputs.bot: Optional new output preset. One of: 9:16 social, 16:9 launch, 1:1 square teaser.

inputs.name: Target Platforms

description.en: Target platforms as a JSON array, e.g. ["instagram","tiktok"].

inputs.bot: Optional JSON array of target platform names.

inputs.name: Selected Skills

description.en: Skill IDs to attach as a JSON array, e.g. ["skill-id"].
description.de: Skill-IDs zum Anhängen als JSON-Array, z.B. ["skill-id"].

inputs.bot: Optional JSON array of skill IDs. Replaces the current selection.

inputs.name: Template

description.en: Re-pin the project to a template variation with new values
description.de: Projekt mit neuen Werten an eine Vorlagen-Variation binden
description.es: Re-pin the project to a template variation with new values
description.fr: Re-pin the project to a template variation with new values
description.ro: Re-pin the project to a template variation with new values
description.it: Re-pin the project to a template variation with new values

inputs.bot: Optional JSON: {"elementVariationId": "...", "mode": "light"|"dark", "values": {field: value}}. Send null to unpin the template. Editing the template sets the project back to draft and clears the previous render.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.es: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.fr: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.ro: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.it: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
